description.value: Cora is a breakfast and lunch restaurant specializing in hearty morning fare with vegetarian and vegan options. Located on busy Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, it offers both dine-in and takeaway service. A convenient refueling stop for touring cyclists passing through the city.
